findings.text: blocking: _pancake_remainder(gamma, r, rp) is exactly nova.biot.zeta.zeta(rp, r, gamma, pi/2) -- the repository's owner for this integral -- measured to 2.4e-14..4.5e-13 relative over gamma in {0, 1e-9, 1e-4, 0.01, 0.4}; the node duplicated it rather than calling the owner. The rule at nova/biot/sheet.py:166 _double_exponential likewise re-implements nova/biot/zeta.py:104 _tanh_sinh_rule, the same s = (1 + tanh(pi/2 sinh t))/2 substitution with a different node count.

non-blocking: test_one_edge_flipped_fails_the_pancake_comparison assembles its own flipped sum from pancake_antiderivative inside the test body, so it never exercises _pancake_flux and cannot redden on a regression in the two-ends assembly it names; the -k pancake mutation arm in negative_control.log left it among the 36 passing.

non-blocking: closed now selects the closed form on a sloped segment but the panelised quadrature on a flat one, so the public keyword inverts its own meaning with geometry; a caller asking for the closed route gets the slower numerical one at slope 0.

non-blocking: _PANCAKE_RULE is built once at import with no lru_cache, unlike every other fixed rule in nova/biot (zeta.py:104, arcbandedcoupling.py:34, gradedresidual.py:77), so the module pays for the rule on import even when only the sloped path is used.

item_verdicts.call_sites: Searched nova/, apps/ and scripts/ for sheet_flux, sheet_field and SheetFlux; the only caller outside nova/biot/sheet.py is tests/test_edge_sheet.py, so the change reaches no production path today.
item_verdicts.diff: Read commit ddbb614 against its base dbbea0e: 3 files changed, +370/-14, the module docstring rewritten to describe the new default route, five new methods added beside the retained flat quadrature, and no existing test edited.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done_when asks for 1e-10 against the reference, 1e-10 against the landed slope-0 values, and a flipped-current control that fails; tests/test_edge_sheet.py:151-219 asserts all three and gate.log records 345 passed EXIT=0, with negative_control.log recording 48 failed EXIT=1 on the pancake comparisons.
item_verdicts.goal: The source goal asks for Urankar Part II eqs (26) and (27) to become the flat (slope 0) flux and field route with the existing quadrature kept as the check; nova/biot/sheet.py:689 _pancake_flux and :700 _pancake_field are that route and _flat_flux/_flat_field survive behind closed=True.
item_verdicts.manifest: The manifest is complete and honest about the routes and the measured 2.84e-13 / 1.68e-12, but its tests field is a JSON object naming no command and it carries no baseline_suite or after_suite arm, so its gate cannot be reconciled against the observed test diff.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The manifest declares nova/biot/sheet.py, tests/test_edge_sheet.py, docs/evidence/fragments/iron-core-magnetisation/icm-pancake-form.html and docs/figures/iron-core-magnetisation/icm-pancake-form; the commit changes only the first three, every one inside the grant.

justifications.durability: the mutated arm in negative_control.log reddens all 12 parameters of test_flat_pancake_form_matches_reference and test_flat_pancake_field_matches_reference (48 failures), so the reference comparison is a real guard, but tests/test_edge_sheet.py:192 test_one_edge_flipped_fails_the_pancake_comparison rebuilds its own flipped sum from pancake_antiderivative and does not redden under that mutation.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_edge_sheet.py:151-219 asserts the reference at TOLERANCE = 1e-10 and the quadrature agreement, and gate.log ends '345 passed' with EXIT=0, but gate.log:1 stamps revision dbbea0e (the base) so the log cannot be tied to the reviewed head ddbb614.
justifications.fit: nova/biot/sheet.py:166-176 builds the rule at import without the lru_cache the rest of nova/biot uses (zeta.py:104, arcbandedcoupling.py:34), and the closed keyword means the quadrature on a flat sheet and the closed form on a sloped one.
justifications.goal_fidelity: nova/biot/sheet.py:602-704 transcribes eqs (26) and (27) for the b_2 = 0 annulus and routes both flux() and field() through them, keeping the older surface-current route reachable behind closed=True.
justifications.reuse: nova/biot/sheet.py:607 _pancake_remainder is nova/biot/zeta.py:189 zeta at alpha = pi/2 (measured agreement 2.4e-14 to 4.5e-13 over gamma 0 to 0.4), and nova/biot/sheet.py:166 _double_exponential re-implements nova/biot/zeta.py:104 _tanh_sinh_rule, the same s = (1 + tanh(pi/2 sinh t))/2 substitution.
justifications.scope_discipline: git show --stat ddbb614 touches nova/biot/sheet.py, tests/test_edge_sheet.py and docs/evidence/fragments/iron-core-magnetisation/icm-pancake-form.html, all three inside the node's declared write paths.
